preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n, x, y, b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the codes n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= y <= n for n, x, y, b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the values x and y satisfy 0 <= x <= y <= n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= b_i <= n+1 for b_i in b) for n, x, y, b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each color b_i in Bob's guess is between 1 and n+1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, x, y, b in test_cases) <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i][0] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first line of the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(result[i][1]) == n for i in range(t) if result[i][0] == 'YES')
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', the next line contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a_i <= n+1 for a_i in result[i][1]) for i in range(t) if result[i][0] == 'YES')
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', each color a_i in Alice's secret code is between 1 and n+1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for j in range(n) if result[i][1][j] == b[j]) == x for i in range(t) if result[i][0] == 'YES')
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', the number of indices where Alice's code matches Bob's guess is x.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(result[i][1]) & set(b)) == y for i in range(t) if result[i][0] == 'YES')
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', the size of the intersection of Alice's code and Bob's guess as multisets is y.
